item.title: Mysterious calls placed from NYC terror suspect family's home hours after alleged ISIS-inspired attack
item.summary: Two Pennsylvania men accused of an ISIS-inspired NYC terror plot lived 10 miles apart but came from vastly different backgrounds before their arrests.

item.title: Spain permanently pulls ambassador from Israel amid Iran war
item.summary: Spain announced on Tuesday it was permanently recalling its ambassador to Israel over its opposition to U.S.-Israeli strikes against Iran.

item.title: Dead Kennedys frontman Jello Biafra hospitalized after suffering hemorrhagic stroke
item.summary: Dead Kennedys frontman Jello Biafra was reportedly hospitalized after suffering a hemorrhagic stroke. The 67-year-old punk rock legend is reportedly stable.

item.title: Colts sign Daniel Jones to record-breaking contract as he recovers from Achilles injury: reports
item.summary: Colts reportedly sign Daniel Jones to a two-year, $88 million contract worth up to $100 million, making it the largest two-year deal in NFL history.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: Trump's SAVE Act ultimatum runs into Senate reality
item.summary: Trump demands Senate Republicans pass SAVE America Act requiring proof of citizenship to vote, but GOP leaders say they lack votes for filibuster.

item.title: House GOP leader launches Senate bid as Trump taps Markwayne Mullin for DHS
item.summary: GOP Rep. Kevin Hern launches his Oklahoma Senate bid to replace DHS nominee Markwayne Mullin, vowing to be a "loyal ally" to President Trump’s "America First" agenda.

item.title: New York governor warned to fix race-based college program or be taken to court
item.summary: New York faces potential lawsuit over college program allegedly discriminating against White and Asian students in science and technology fields.

item.title: Top US court hands Trump a win on deportations as SCOTUS challenge looms
item.summary: A US appeals court intervened at the last minute to greenlight Trump's third-country deportation policy from taking force, handing the administration a win — if only temporarily.

item.title: Epstein accountant testifies he never saw 'any type of transaction' with Trump, Comer says
item.summary: Epstein accountant Richard Kahn testified he saw no payments to Donald Trump, as House Oversight Chair James Comer reveals five major figures who funded Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Florida mom accused of abandoning daughter at Universal Studios to go drinking at bar
item.summary: A Florida mother was arrested and charged with child neglect after allegedly leaving her 12-year-old daughter alone at a Universal CityWalk bar while she went drinking elsewhere, authorities said.
